title: MCDE Recipe Fix
description: Fixes MC Dungeons Enchanting's recipes, which do not work on some versions.
body:
![MCDE Recipe Fix Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d607fd9b15317f22eb413d3a5c1b95244a73a8c3.png)
# What does it do?

> **MCDE Recipe Fix** fixes [MC Dungeons Enchanting](https://modrinth.com/mod/mc-dungeons-enchanting)'s recipes for the Runic Table, Roll Bench and Gilding Foundry, as they do not work on some versions. This simple mods adds their original recipes to the game, fully working with mods like JEI and EMI, etc. Just as it should be!
